column1: FLIPPED layout:  ROWS = dimensions    COLUMNS = token IDs     shape (d x V)
Same data rotated 90°. A COLUMN is one token’s vector (what the model looks up). A ROW is one dimension across every token.
Look down a COLUMN to see one token (token ID lookup). Look across a ROW to see one unlabeled dimension shared by all tokens.
Neither layout is more true. Code almost always stores (V, d) = tokens as rows. Diagrams sometimes draw (d, V) = dims as rows.
